DashboardBearer.description: Signed dashboard access_token returned by POST /dashboard/auth/login. Valid for 24 hours; no server-side sessions.

post.summary: Log in with a dashboard account
post.description: Returns a signed dashboard Bearer token valid for 24 hours, without server-side sessions. Passwords contain 6 to 128 characters. Login is case insensitive. Unknown, inactive and deleted accounts return the same credentials error. Limited to 10 attempts per login and 30 per IP in 15 minutes.

post.summary: Create a dashboard owner or admin account
post.description: Only an active dashboard owner can create accounts, including additional owners. The actor comes from the Bearer token. Passwords contain 6 to 128 characters and are hashed with Argon2id.

get.summary: List Qubnix users with purchase and subscription statistics
get.description: Available to dashboard owners and admins. Search is applied before pagination. Purchases count distinct organizations with paid create_organization orders, including subsequently deleted organizations. Renewals do not increase purchase counts. Amounts and last payment count only currently paid orders. Personal workspaces and deleted organizations are excluded from current ownership and active paid counts. IDs and UZS amounts are returned as strings.

get.summary: List companies with owners, subscriptions and purchase statistics
get.description: Owners and admins can read. Excludes personal and deleted organizations. Search matches company or owner names, phone, username and IDs. Purchases include original paid events even when later cancelled. Net paid totals exclude cancelled payments. Legacy purchases with no recorded amounts have total_paid_uzs=null. Missing purchase dates stay null. Projects exclude the system default project; tasks count nondeleted top-level tasks in nondeleted projects.

total_paid_uzs.description: Whole UZS string; null when the amount is not recorded

get.summary: Read the chronological company purchase and subscription history
get.description: With organization_id, returns that company's events; otherwise returns all company events, including archived companies. Newest events first. A paid-then-cancelled order retains both events. Dates, amounts, discounts and periods come from stored orders. Plan names reflect the current label of their recorded plan IDs. Legacy purchase entries appear only without a matching modern initial purchase; unknown fields are null.

amount_uzs.description: Whole UZS string; null when the amount is not recorded

get.summary: Get current dashboard totals and revenue for the date range
get.description: from/to affect only revenue. Counts reflect the current nondeleted client users and team companies. Active subscriptions belong to live team companies, have an available plan, have started and have not expired. Counts both new company purchases and renewals using currently paid orders and paid_at. Stored amounts already include discounts. Cancelled, failed and unpaid orders are excluded. Archiving a company, purchaser or plan does not remove paid history. Legacy purchases without recorded amounts are excluded. Long-term payments are booked in full in their payment month, without proration.
